---
title: "TKBM262615 Practicals"
---

Lecture notes and hands-on Jupyter notebooks for **TBM263214 Komputasi Biologi** (Computational Biology), Biomedical Engineering, Universitas Gadjah Mada. The book renders the instructor-solved version of each practical. The exercise versions (without solutions) run directly in [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/); each lecture note carries an *Open In Colab* button for its practical.

## Lecture notes → practicals

| Lecture | Solved practical(s) |
|---|---|
| L02 — The Mathematical Toolkit | [01 ODE intro](instructor/01_ode_intro_solutions.ipynb) |
| L03 — Reaction Networks and Mass Action | [02 Mass action](instructor/02_mass_action_solutions.ipynb), [02 Simple networks](instructor/02_simple_networks_solutions.ipynb) |
| L04 — Conservation and Numerical Simulation | [02 Simple networks](instructor/02_simple_networks_solutions.ipynb) (incl. Euler's method) |
| L05 — Enzyme Kinetics I | [03 Enzyme kinetics I](instructor/03_enzyme_kinetics_I_solutions.ipynb) |
| L06 — Enzyme Kinetics II | [04 Enzyme kinetics II](instructor/04_enzyme_kinetics_II_solutions.ipynb) (incl. Hill fitting) |
| L07 — Constraint-Based Analysis | [cell-factory-design-course](https://github.com/lab-biotek-bio-ugm/cell-factory-design-course): notebooks 01–03 (external repo; open the student versions in Colab) |
